notes.title: Kotodama is out now!
notes.content:
[h1]Why not check out our launch trailer![/h1]
So it's finally out there. 
Our first development project. 

Not going to lie, we are nervous as hell today! A massive thanks to everyone who has wishlist our game - an even bigger thanks to everyone who is taking the plunge and buying day one!

If you're still on the fence, then you can check out our launch trailer below:

https://youtu.be/XZOJxe9dMcE

We really hope that you enjoy what we've made. For Kotodama it's been very much a learning experience for us. 

It's the first game we've made from the ground up. It's kinda quirky and, we hope, a Visual Novel that will surprise you to the very end.

We wanted to players to finish the game and think '[i]well, I wasn't expecting that![/i]'. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/96d001cf110df5481cb6ee924b864bf25cf9683f.png[/img]

It's hard for us to gauge whether we've achieved that when we already know the surprises in store. We hope we managed to deliver what we set out to!

All being well - and that is, if you don't HATE it - we'd love to start working on the sequel and begin exploring some of the cast in more detail.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/a4e3cab4ca288eb6a7cf8f3b42c8229f01bc3edf.png[/img]

As ever, we are so thankful for your support, your kind posts of encouragement and any feedback (both positive and negative!) that you've taken time out to send to us over the last 6 months.

Love to you all, you're the best!
The PQube Team
xxx

notes.title: Character Introduction - Chinatsu Hachisuka
notes.content:
[h1]CHINATSU HACHISUKA[/h1]
There's always one isn't there! Chinatsu is the Bossy Tsundere of Fujisawa Academy. She spends her days patrolling the Academy Hallways dishing out grief to anyone who dares to turn up late for class, or run in the corridors.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/dc319f35ecdeb871fcceeb84bea50a29aa839345.png[/img] 

Yup, this girl is tsundere through and through. So much so, you have to wonder if this girl has any redeeming qualities. Seriously, she needs to chill. She's always hanging around Kujo too - as though she doesn't have anything better to do.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/a36b92f6ba927b89ecd22a5c12964dc9b6715497.png[/img]


But the thing is - she definitely has something to hide and it's arguably one of Fujisawa Academy's biggest secrets. Because for an Academy of such importance in the community, no one - and I mean NO ONE - has ever seen the principal. Some people claim to know who he is, others deny all knowledge...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/b7ed76bfbd414e67f817a3c7fbebc17ada1da490.png[/img]

...with some smart use of your Kotodama power, maybe Chinatsu will be able shed some light on this mystery...

notes.title: Character Introduction - Kujo Satsuki
notes.content:
[h1]KUJO SATSUKI[/h1]
Kujo Satsuki is Fujisawa Academy's finest student. Quickwitted and sharp - his grade average is, frankly, outrageous. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/f1d4ea806e3d95bf1d5d292ee6fa99e3db0675ca.png[/img]

President of the Student Council - he also knows more about Fujisawa's inner workings than any other Student and an excellent source of information.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/b279d16567e80e9affe4c4ae22518a94fd274a76.png[/img]

He's also a bona fide Honor Scholar, which, as many of the other students know, grants him special... privileges.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/7b663c9af5c7d319ac992245cfa44d06ede41f26.png[/img]

Given his high status at the Academy though, he is universally well liked. He's easy going and always happy to help his fellow students. He has no superiority complex, even though you'd forgive him for having one.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/46303bb49de2c6b78a671b475617da0e9a2b42a7.png[/img]

But despite all this, he is unusually close to one to of the Seven Mysteries and it doesn't take him long to have a very keen interest in what the Occult Research Club is up to.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/4c0791a2d770636be99a02cd42e50cada3ecd60f.png[/img]

Kotodama: The 7 Mysteries of Fujisawa is releasing on Steam, PS4 and Nintendo Switch. Why not wishlist today and get updated with new info as we get closer to launch.

notes.title: Check out the new Character Trailer
notes.content:
[h1]MEET THE CAST OF KOTODAMA![/h1]
A quick heads up for you today, because we've recently revealed the full character roster for Kotodama in its very own trailer. You can see the new trailer on our store page - or you can check it out on our YouTube channel here:

https://youtu.be/bm_NHyN-8EA

One thing many people have asked, which this trailer finally shows is that Kotodama is fully voice acted in Japanese.

That is with the exception of you, the protagonist, of course!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/f96d07b182194fcdc64e538d8dfac05cb93dd78c.png[/img]

There are some nice examples of some of Kotodama's other elements too - like dialogue choices, your Kotodama power leveling up by finding key words, and also some of the Kotodama Battle powers too, like Bomb, and Double Damage. You also get to see Chinatsu powering her Hindrance Attacks as well.

Kotodama: The 7 Mysteries of Fujisawa releases on the 31st of May on Steam. Be sure to hit the Wishlist for further updates and character intros.

notes.title: Character Introduction - Wakaba Asagiri
notes.content:
[h1]WAKABA ASAGIRI[/h1]
You could say that, after Nanami Kagura, Wakaba Asagiri is one of the most important characters in Kotodama: The 7 Mysteries of Fujisawa. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/beb60cfe47f669bec1e623a16652c4135cc8fec7.png[/img]

You see, Wakaba is the President of the Occult Research Club. Their role is to investigate the Seven Mysteries at the Academy and get to the bottom of it. With your... [i]unique skills[/i], it doesn't take long for Wakaba to try to enlist you.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/b68b0b8da4f8adc4ac78233b6e47597df02e72b4.png[/img]

Wakaba is, in many ways, one of the most normal students at the Academy. She's happy go lucky, reliable and level headed... or so you'd think.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/50030e33c8a54bc47c635a97b4c9e0f0de090a7c.png[/img]

Deep down though she has her own insecurities, particularly when it comes to romance. Is there anything this girl wouldn't do for love?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/8ec970e46e58bf97b04cfe7ae154147a4c17bd4b.png[/img]

If you want to find out, you're going to have to deep dive with your Kotodama power - but it won't be easy. Wakaba's hindrance attack includes a shield, which can block your power in the confrontational battles for the truth.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/0836a67b5fd34bf2f9ff98e543ad60c0bf9afad8.png[/img]

If you'd like to keep up with Kotodama news, news from PQube, promotions and giveaways, then why not join our discord server! https://discord.gg/RaHFT29

notes.title: Character Introduction - Yukino Tsubaki
notes.content:
[h1]YUKINO TSUBAKI[/h1]
Considered by many at Fujisawa Academy as being nothing but a spoilt rich kid, Yukino Tsubaki is best described as... 'frosty'.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/3976dbe6d3e1ab6511c1d04a88d62fad94312fde.png[/img]

You certainly shouldn't get on the wrong side of her - which is exactly what Nanami Kagura, your best friend on campus, has done. It's safe to say these two hate each other with a passion.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/96d001cf110df5481cb6ee924b864bf25cf9683f.png[/img]

Fact is though, underneath her hard exterior, when you get her on her own, Yukino can be really nice - so why does she find it so hard to show it?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/faa006d033ea2a00dcb5e34d7826676789e489bd.png[/img]

Nice as she may be, that doesn't mean she has nothing to hide. Like why does she keep sneaking into the Academy after dark? And more to the point, who is she meeting there... and why?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/784a0e3330a91c0f16e9c7e493e7d7f8e161c48c.jpg[/img]

Kotodama: The 7 Mysteries of Fujisawa is our brand new Visual Novel - focusing on the mysterious Fujisawa Academy and the students secrets on campus.

Together with your Demon Fox, Mon-chan, you must investigate the students and, wielding the power of Kotodama - a means of forcing the truth out of your target - you must get to the bottom of the Academy's secrets...

Why not hit our 'Wishlist' for more updates as we get close to launch! ^_^

notes.title: Character Introduction - Shuji Toyama
notes.content:
[h1]SHUJI TOYAMA[/h1]
Fujisawa Academy's Track and Field Ace - Shuji Toyama is one fo the most popular students on campus...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/29adb2bacafcc12e6d8ddf9ce69a9345da53a7a1.png[/img]

In fact, he's so popular that he even has his own fan club - groupies that follow him wherever he goes and love to watch him train.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/b8fb53da0c76613ddcc4cc93ff8ce44c56205750.png[/img]

You'd think that all this attention would make him a big-headed douche, but... actually, Shuji's a pretty stand-up guy. Even tempered, considerate and an all round decent fella, he's particularly well liked by students and staff alike. That's not to say he doesn't have his share of skeletons in the closet, mind.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/6221cece9443d04e49131dd7298d0d04e46aaa1d.png[/img]

See, both Shuji's track times and grades have been slipping recently - with a number of no-shows in training.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/ec1368ad7192d153236e6115baf58af91082875b.png[/img]

And where, exactly, does he keep disappearing off to? You're going to have to gather some evidence and confront him - before calling on the power of Kotodama, to get to the bottom of it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/f0a9ff3beeb0101f18481743f8b3407c209c319e.png[/img]

notes.title: Character Introduction - Honoka Ichinose
notes.content:
[h1]HONOKA ICHINOSE[/h1]
For today's character introduction I want to talk about Honoka Ichinose. 

For those of you who maybe didn't catch our earlier announcements, Kotodama: The 7 Mysteries of Fujisawa is primarily a visual novel, and each chapter focuses on a specific character and mystery. The first chapter is the Mystery of the White Wolf - of which Honoka is the central character.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/502975bd66ca323294d1d1da4db66537102dd1cd.png[/img]


You meet Honoka very early on. She's a little shy, but well liked. She spends quite a bit of time alone and it is well known that she loves cute animals.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/cb083a03ecfa6333d95370e61c06f9daa3bfcb64.png[/img]

But here's the thing. Animals don't seem to like her back. And while she's clearly a lovely girl, there's a real sadness to Honoka - if only you could figure out why...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/0a6890880ecaee0a03c21e8d9202e70916def97a.png[/img]


Only one way to find out! Wielding the power of Kotodama, you can get to the truth - whether you like what you find, of course, is another thing entirely.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/a683278bd7725839ff05c87116cffd0834640be5.jpg[/img]


Want to get more updates on our upcoming games? Then why not join our discord and say Hi to the PQube Team :) https://discord.gg/RaHFT29

notes.title: Character Introduction - Nanami Kagura
notes.content:
[h1]NANAMI KAGURA[/h1]
Today we wanted to start introducing the main characters you'll meet in Kotodama: The 7 Mysteries of Fujisawa.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/d527c1574ad1957ed95ade8d8a4a1b58e59ddad4.png[/img]


It's fair to say that the first, most important character you'll meet is Nanami Kagura. Outside of Mon-chan, the little demon fox, she's the first character you come across.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/1962d419c98a86074ed83290e4114c12b3a3e157.png[/img]

She's sweet, kind-hearted and a constant bundle of energy, she also takes you under her wing and gives you the initial tour of the Fujisawa Academy.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/61e094390002be259038a5dec7416a230f5c370e.png[/img]


She's also important in that she's also involved in your first attempt at using your power - Kotodama. This the means by which you strip your target in a bid to get to the truth.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/50b762b3a5f02e1a49ff43c80fb82868aefe134e.png[/img]

But underneath all that rampant enthusiasm for life, you soon detect just a twinge of sadness. What's bothering her? Why is she so obsessed with the 'Curse of Mikoto' - one of the seven mysteries of Fujisawa?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/f9ac720918f9cdcf4e1dd79d17c9d2c6fa3d9572.png[/img]

We have a soft spot for Nanami, mainly because she's one of the first characters we created. Above is a little of the original concept art when we were developing. She's been with us from the start, so she has a special place in our heart!

If you'd like to keep up to date with Kotodama news, then why not check out our Official Discord here: https://discord.gg/8X69jtG

notes.title: Thank you for finding Kotodama
notes.content:
[h1]HELLO EVERYONE - WE MADE A GAME! PLEASE BE GENTLE![/h1]
If you've found yourself on this [i]Kotodama: The 7 Mysteries for Fujisawa[/i] page, then we'd like to say a big thank you for coming here.

Some of you may be here because you've been kind enough to play PQube's games before. If so then, hello again. You're The Best.

If you're completely new to us, as a publisher, then welcome - we hope you like what you find here, and choose to stick around! :)


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/4c470c248379421c335cdc786de82ec31225a360.png[/img]


You may or may not know that [i]Kotodama[/i] is actually PQube's very first New IP.  'New IP' being the sort of phrasing that we secretly hate because it's what our corporate overlords sometimes say - but the fact is, this is our first project where we've been involved in producing a game from concept to completion.


Normally we publish other people's games. We look for games we like. Games which are kind of... er... [i]interesting[/i]. Or slightly left-field, or, well... a bit ecchi, or cute, or both. 

We also like Visual Novels, like, A LOT. So it sort of made sense to make a game which was a little bit VN, a little bit Ecchi and, well, also a little bit unusual.


Developing [i]Kotodama[/i] with our friends, Art Co. in Japan has been a BIG learning curve for us - sometimes scary and stressful, but mostly fun!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698824/a4e3cab4ca288eb6a7cf8f3b42c8229f01bc3edf.png[/img]


We hope that Kotodama gives you some '[i]well, I wasn't expecting that![/i]' feels - maybe makes you laugh a little bit. Hopefully surprise you and give you some genuine 'WTF?!' moments. But mostly in a [i]good way.[/i]

Being our very first development project, we also hope that any long-time PQube fans can support us. Even just hitting 'wishlist' can go a long way to helping out. All being well, with your support, Kotodama can continue on. 

Think of this as the seed, as it were. If you, our community, can help it grow, then we can continue this universe and the story of the characters. We hope this is just the beginning.


A HUGE thanks to all of you who have been so supportive of us so far!
The PQube Team
xxx

P.S - If you'd like join Kotodama's discord then you can find, and chat with us about this project, right here: https://discord.gg/9D8k78P
